data.title: Let a user see what kadence put into their agent's context, and what it cost
data.description: The reviewer's first question was not whether it works but how: 'it's important to understand how my agent would utilize this context', and whether it compacts or embeds when the context window runs out. Today the answer lives in the README's cost table and in our heads. A user cannot see, in their own session, what prime and the prompt hook added and how many tokens it was.
